from collections import deque
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    comps=[]; seen=set()
    for s in cells:
        if s in seen: continue
        q=deque([s]); comp=[]; seen.add(s)
        while q:
            r,c=q.popleft(); comp.append((r,c))
            for dr in(-1,0,1):
                for dc in(-1,0,1):
                    n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and n not in seen and g[n[0]][n[1]]==g[s[0]][s[1]] and n not in comp:
                        # same-color adjacency (4-conn + diag along lines)
                        seen.add(n); q.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,comp in enumerate(comps):
        others=[p for j,c2 in enumerate(comps) for p in c2 if j!=i]
        if not others: continue
        cr=sum(p[0] for p in others)/len(others); cc=sum(p[1] for p in others)/len(others)
        # outermost cell farthest from others' centroid
        best=max(comp,key=lambda p:(p[0]-cr)**2+(p[1]-cc)**2)
        r0,c0=best; col=g[r0][c0]
        dirs=[]
        for dr,dc in ((-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)):

            if (dr*(r0-cr)+dc*(c0-cc))>0: dirs.append((dr,dc))
        for dr,dc in dirs:
            r,c=r0+dr,c0+dc
            while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
                out[r][c]=col; r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    if not fg: return [r[:] for r in g]
    cr=sum(p[0] for p in fg)/len(fg); cc=sum(p[1] for p in fg)/len(fg)
